name: Stability Ball Pike Push-Up
steps: Assume a high plank with your hands planted slightly wider than shoulder-width on the floor and your shins resting on top of a stability ball.
Brace your trunk and draw the ball forward with your feet as you lift your hips into a pike.
Holding the high pike position, bend your elbows to lower the crown of your head smoothly toward the floor slightly ahead of your hands.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms, then guide the ball back until you reach a plank.
tips: Keep your core tightly braced so the stability ball stays locked beneath your feet during the press.
Lower slowly with full control rather than rushing toward the floor.
